transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because when I start eating, it feels like I kind of lose control. Like I’m telling myself to stop, but I just keep going, and it feels like something else has taken over until I can’t stand it anymore.
Do you feel guilty after these eating episodes?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I know I feel bad afterward, but I don’t know if I’d call it guilt exactly. It’s more just… I don’t feel good about it.
Have you experienced any problems with sexual interest or function?
I haven’t really noticed anything like that, no. I’m not sure if I’d say there’s a problem there.
Do you eat an amount of food that is larger than what most people would eat in a similar time period during these episodes?

Yeah. It’s definitely more than a normal amount. Like after studying, I’ll leave the dining hall and then go back to my room and keep eating—burgers, cereal, peanut butter, snacks, just whatever I have. It can get to the point where the trash is full and I feel sick afterward.
How often do these episodes of eating more than you intended happen?
It’s been happening several times a week, for most of this semester. I don’t think there’s really been a week in the last few months where it just stopped or anything.
Do you usually eat during these episodes when you're alone?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I think it happens sometimes when I’m by myself, but I haven’t paid close attention to whether that’s always the case.
Do you ever try to make up for the amount you ate during these episodes by doing something to compensate, like exercising or vomiting?

Yeah… I do. After I eat like that, I usually go find a bathroom in the dorm, or sometimes a quiet floor in the library, and make myself throw up. I just get really scared that the food is sitting there and it’s going to turn into weight.
How often do you make yourself throw up after one of these eating episodes?

It’s several times a week, usually after those eating episodes. It’s been like that for most of this semester… not really just once in a while. Looking back, I don’t think there’s been a week in the last few months where it fully stopped.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a large amount of food and feel like you've lost control, but you don't make yourself throw up afterward?
Yeah. Sometimes once I start eating, it’s like I’m not really in control anymore. I’m telling myself to stop, but I just keep going until I feel like I can’t stand it.
How often do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food and feel like you've lost control, but you don't make yourself throw up afterward?
I’m not totally sure. I don’t really keep track of the times when I don’t throw up afterward. I just know it happens sometimes, but I’d have a hard time giving an exact number.
How many times a month would you say you have these episodes of eating a large amount of food and feeling like you've lost control, but you don't make yourself throw up afterward?
I really don’t know. I haven’t been counting those ones, and they kind of blur together. I know it happens, but I couldn’t give you a real number for a month.
Do these episodes where you eat a large amount of food and feel like you've lost control, but you don't make yourself throw up afterward, happen at least once a week?

I’m not sure if it’s every week. I haven’t really kept track, and I don’t want to guess and give you the wrong answer. It does happen sometimes, but I can’t say for sure that it’s at least once a week.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food, feel like you've lost control, and don't make yourself throw up afterward at least once a week on average?
I can’t really say yes to that. I know it happens sometimes, but I haven’t tracked it closely enough to know if it averages out to once a week.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food and feel like you've lost control, but you don't make yourself throw up afterward, at least 2 times a week on average?
I don’t think I can say it’s at least two times a week. I know it happens, but I haven’t been tracking it closely enough to give that number for sure.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food, feel like you've lost control, and don't make yourself throw up afterward at least 3 times a month?
I’m not sure about three times a month either. I know there are times it happens, but I haven’t been counting it like that, so I don’t want to say yes if I’m not sure.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food and feel like you've lost control, but you don't make yourself throw up afterward, at least once a month?
I’m not really sure. It might be around once a month, but I haven’t kept track closely enough to say yes for sure.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food, feel like you've lost control, and don't make yourself throw up afterward?

Yes. That does happen. Once I start eating, it feels like I kind of lose control, like I’m not fully there anymore. Even if I’m telling myself to stop, I just keep going until I feel like I can’t stand it.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food, feel like you've lost control, and don't make yourself throw up afterward more often than the episodes where you do make yourself throw up?

No, I think it’s more often that I do make myself throw up afterward. After I eat like that, I usually end up finding a bathroom in the dorm or somewhere quiet, like a floor of the library, because I’m scared the food is just sitting there and turning into weight.

Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food, feel like you've lost control, and don't make yourself throw up afterward at least as often as you have episodes where you do make yourself throw up?

No, not as often. Most of the time after I eat like that, I end up going to a bathroom in the dorm or somewhere quiet, like a library floor, and making myself throw up because I’m terrified the food is just sitting there turning into weight.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food, feel like you've lost control, and don't make yourself throw up afterward more than 3 times a month?
I’m not really sure about the exact number. I know it happens sometimes, but I haven’t been keeping count, so I don’t want to say for sure that it’s more than three times a month.
